title: Rigidity for Isomorphisms between Operator Algebras with Commutative Diagonals
summary: We show that two families of operator algebras, the CSL algebras of multiplicity free CSLs and the semicrossed products of commutative C$^*$-algebras, demonstrate a strong form of rigidity with respect to isometric isomorphisms. Specifically, the isomorphism class of any such algebra remains unchanged within its family, even if we allow for isomorphism after tensoring with operator algebras containing the compact operators. For semicrossed products of commutative C$^*$-algebras, the same conclusion holds even when tensoring with operator algebras whose diagonals are irreducibly acting.…
